title: Wizard city homepage — proposed Pages flow
content:
flowchart LR
  V[Visitor] -->|actual address not yet known| H[GitHub Pages: observed disabled; no branch selected]
  H -. proposed source after separate authorization .-> M[main:/docs]
  M -->|future candidate; not yet created| D[docs/index.html: static, inline CSS, no external assets]
  D --> P[https://github.com/WebeWizard/webe-city]
  D --> R[https://github.com/justin-leis/webe-opolis]
  M -. future docs changes auto-publish by resident choice .-> H
  A[Separate resident authorization for Pages enablement and publication] -. required .-> H
  O[Resident states they will maintain; review each deployment result] -. operating plan, not authenticated identity .-> H
  U[Documented unpublish/redeploy option; availability and recovery untested] -. only with separate authority .-> H
  I[Independent inspection and resident acceptance] -. separate post-delivery steps .-> D
